fact: Enabel's final evaluation of June 2026 reports that interoperability between the civil registry and PN-RAVEC has not been activated for lack of a political decision, and that implementing texts of laws L/2023/0019 and L/2023/0020 must be accelerated.
title: Executive summary: Pilot Project for Improving the Guinean Civil Registration System through the Catalytic Effect of Digitalization (PARECIGUI Ext Phase 2)
